components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (one of MR, MRS, MS
            or DR). When present it prefixes the read-only 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for
            backward compatibility with the flat address form; the structured
            'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are preferred when present. On
            output it is the composed, normalized address: the normalized
            'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present, or the
            normalized flat address when no structured address was supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (street number and name). Preferred over the flat 'address' field
            when supplied; normalized on create.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (unit, suite, etc.). When present it is normalized and
            appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 200'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped;
            a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise
            country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped
            from the national digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+', and that E.164 string is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be valid for the city's region per a fixed table (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. An out-of-range or malformed postcode is
            rejected with 400. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it is used to derive the read-only 'ageBand'.
            Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag acknowledging, on create, that this owner
            deliberately shares a household with an existing owner (same last
            name and address). When true the owner is not flagged as a possible
            (soft) duplicate.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Identity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's version-2 derived identifiers. Every identifier mixes in a
        fixed 'V2' version tag so it changes between versions and no value produced
        under version 1 is produced again.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>':
            the version-2 region code (the plain region with the 'V2' tag mixed in),
            the two-digit fiscal year (starting 1 July) that contains the
            registration date, the first eight upper-case hex characters of the
            SHA-256 digest over (normalizedTelephone + lastName), and a single Luhn
            check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
          type: string
          example: 'NSWV226A1B2C3D40'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household: the
            leading hex characters of the SHA-256 digest over the 'V2' version tag,
            the owner's normalized last name and postcode. Owners with the same last
            name and postcode share it automatically.
          type: string
          example: '3f2504e04f89'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            The owner's derived identity key: the SHA-256 hex digest of
            'V2|normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (the email segment
            is empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole
            identity key matches; a create is rejected with 409 Conflict in that case.
          type: string
          example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
          readOnly: true
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the honorific 'title' followed by a
                single space and the last name when a title is on file, or just
                the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country calling
                code with its leading '+', a space, then the national digits grouped
                in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The owner-identity API version. Version 2 groups the owner's
                derived identifiers under 'identity' and derives each of them with
                a version-tagged algorithm. Always 2.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared its first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year (starting 1 July) that contains the
                business-day-adjusted registration date, formatted 'FY<YY>' using
                the last two digits of the fiscal year's starting calendar year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. Starts at 0, gains 2 when an email
                address is on file, gains 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), gains 2 for a household of 3 or more, and
                gains 3 when tenure exceeds one fiscal year (fiscal years start
                1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 8
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived from membershipPoints:
                level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the canonical region derived from the city
                using a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne ->
                VIC, Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the
                table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived from the locality region using
                a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC ->
                Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the
                region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created for this
                owner's registration date, flagging an unusually high volume of
                same-day registrations; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when this owner's city already holds between 40 and 49
                owners, signalling that it is approaching the per-city capacity
                limit of 50; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is on file, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'PHONE'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from 'birthDate' as at the
                registration date: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birth date is on file.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM'
                when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is
                'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at creation, another owner had a different identity key
                but shared this owner's last-name sound (soundex) and postcode (a soft
                match that does not block creation); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner softly matched on last-name
                sound (soundex) and postcode at creation, present only when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true; absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when any soft risk signal holds for this owner: it is a
                possible duplicate, its email domain is disposable-adjacent
                (belongs to a known disposable-email provider's family, such as a
                sibling TLD or subdomain), or its city is over its soft capacity
                (holding between 40 and 49 owners); otherwise false.

## Summary

I released version 2 of the owner identity. The change centers on a single new concept — `model/OwnerIdentityVersion` — that holds the `CURRENT` version number (2) and the fixed `TAG` (`"V2"`) mixed into every identifier. Each identifier mixes the tag in idiomatically, and each derived value has a single, well-scoped home:

**Identity derivation (tag mixed in → every identifier changes, no v1 value recurs):**
- `MemberIdGenerator` region — `ClinicServiceImpl` now builds the region as `Locality.forOwner(owner) + "V2"`, so `memberId` becomes e.g. `NSWV226...`.
- `OwnerIdentity.key` — prepends `V2|` to the SHA-256 input.
- `Households.householdId` — prepends `V2|` to the SHA-256 input.

**User-facing values stay plain (no tag):**
- `OwnerMapper.formatLocality` now derives the plain region directly via `Locality.forOwner` instead of parsing it back out of the (now-tagged) `memberId`. `timezone` and the owner segment follow from that plain locality, so `locality` stays `NSW` and the segment stays `..._METRO`. The now-dead `Locality.fromMemberId` was removed.

**Response shape (`openapi.yml` → regenerated DTOs):**
- Added a new `OwnerIdentity` schema grouping `memberId`, `householdId`, `identityKey`; the `Owner` schema now exposes them only under a nested `identity` object plus a top-level integer `apiVersion` (2). The mapper builds the nested object in a small `toIdentity` helper.

**Audit schema v2:**
- `OwnerCreatedEvent` gained `schemaVersion` (2) and an `ownerSegment` recomputed from the v2 identity using the plain region and membership level — matching the segment in the owner response.

Request fields (`OwnerFields`) were left untouched, as required. Confirmed via the emitted audit line: `{"schemaVersion":2,...,"memberId":"NSWV22616E6609E9",...,"ownerSegment":"STANDARD_METRO","event":"OWNER_CREATED"}`.
